`qrcode-generator-2.0.4.js` is the browser build of qrcode-generator 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase.

Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
License: MIT (see `LICENSE-qrcode-generator.txt`)

It is bundled locally so the TOTP enrollment URI is encoded in the browser without sending the secret to a QR service or third-party CDN.
